newsitem.title: UK: Baltic, Black Sea exports unchanged in 4th wk Apri.
newsitem.headline: Baltic, Black Sea exports unchanged in 4th wk Apri.

text.p: Exports of crude oil and refined products from Baltic and Black Sea terminals were little changed at 1.756 million bpd in the fourth week of April from 1.754 million the week before, Petro Logistics said.
The total was down 73,000 bpd in the same week last year.

The Geneva-based consultancy, tracking tanker movements, said crude oil exports from Baltic and Black Sea ports rose by 76,000 bpd on the week to 1.12 million bpd. This was 27,00 bpd up on year-ago levels.
Heavy fuel exports were just 149,745, down 121,000 bpd on the week and 231,000 bpd down on the year.
Gas oil exports at 354,000 bpd were 47,000 bpd down week-on-week and 29,000 bpd up year-on-year.
